title: Style and Technique in Classic Fiction
text:
Classic fiction often rewards readers who pay attention to style as closely as to plot. Writers such as Jane Austen relied on free indirect discourse, a technique that lets the narrator's voice blend with a character's thoughts without quotation marks. Through this blend, irony can emerge quietly, because the reader sees a character's self-deception while the character remains unaware of it. Such subtle choices shape how we judge people long before the story tells us whom to trust.

Equally important is the deliberate use of pacing and imagery. Authors frequently lengthen a scene to build tension, then compress several years into a single sentence to signal the passage of time. Recurring images, such as a letter, a window, or a storm, can accumulate meaning until they carry the emotional weight of an entire chapter. Readers who notice these patterns often discover that the novel is arguing with itself beneath its surface.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what does free indirect discourse allow?
options: Dialogue to be printed in italics
The narrator's voice to blend with a character's thoughts without quotation marks
A character to speak directly to the reader in verse
The plot to be told in reverse order

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do authors do to signal the passage of time?
options: They repeat the same image in every chapter
They lengthen a scene with long dialogue
They compress several years into a single sentence
They add footnotes to each chapter

questions.text: What is the main effect of irony in the free indirect style described in paragraph one?
options: It makes the narrator appear unreliable and dishonest
It lets readers notice a gap between what a character believes and what is true
It forces the reader to skip sections of the text
It replaces the need for a clear plot

questions.text: What does the final sentence of paragraph two suggest about careful readers?
options: They are likely to dislike novels with complex structures
They can detect layers of meaning that run against the surface story
They usually read a book more than once to memorize it
They prefer recurring images to dialogue

paragraph_translations: Класична література часто винагороджує читачів, які уважно стежать за стилем так само, як і за сюжетом. Письменники на кшталт Джейн Остін покладалися на вільну непряму мову, прийом, що дозволяє голосу оповідача зливатися з думками персонажа без лапок. Завдяки такому поєднанню іронія може непомітно проступати, адже читач бачить самообман персонажа, тоді як сам персонаж цього не усвідомлює. Такі тонкі вибори формують наше ставлення до людей задовго до того, як історія підкаже, кому можна довіряти.

Не менш важливими є навмисне використання темпу та образності. Автори часто подовжують сцену, щоб наростити напругу, а потім стискають кілька років в одне речення, щоб позначити плин часу. Повторювані образи, такі як лист, вікно чи буря, можуть накопичувати значення, доки не понесуть емоційну вагу цілого розділу. Читачі, які помічають ці закономірності, часто розуміють, що роман під своєю поверхнею сперечається сам із собою.
